summary.text: Larry Miller is a Democratic state representative from Tennessee House District 88 who has served since 1994 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is a retired Memphis firefighter.

paragraphs.text: Larry Miller earned a B.A. in social science from LeMoyne-Owen College, according to Ballotpedia, and is a retired firefighter with the Memphis Fire Department.
He assumed office in Tennessee House District 88 in 1994.
For the 2023-2024 session Ballotpedia lists him on the Finance, Ways, and Means, Local Government and State Government committees.
